rules.name: Aspen: Cover file named cover.jpg
Aspen: Cover height is 1100 pixels
Aspen: Cover image is 300 DPI
Aspen: Back cover image is not required
Aspen: EPUB file named '<eISBN>_EPUB.epub'
Aspen: Front Matter present in NAV
Aspen: 'Half title' word forbidden in NAV/NCX
Aspen: Authors separated by ',' not 'and' in OPF/NCX
Aspen: Copyright page must not contain 'Printed'
Aspen: Copyright page must contain the eISBN
Aspen: OPF dc:publisher = 'Aspen Publishing'
Aspen: OPF dc:rights matches Aspen copyright pattern
Aspen: OPF certifier = 'S4Carlisle Publishing Services'
Aspen: OPF dcterms:conformsTo = EPUB Accessibility 1.1 - WCAG 2.2 Level AA
Aspen: <dc:title> is Title Case / Upper Lower Case
Aspen: <dc:date> is the current calendar year
Aspen: <dc:format> page count matches PDF page count
Aspen: <dc:source> is a urn:isbn Print ISBN + source-of=pagination refines it
Aspen: <dc:identifier> id follows 'Epub-<eISBN>' convention
Aspen: <meta name="cover" content="..."/> resolves to a manifest item
Aspen: accessibilityHazard contains noSoundHazard, noMotionSimulationHazard, and none
Aspen: accessMode contains both 'textual' and 'visual'
Aspen: accessModeSufficient contains both 'textual,visual' and 'textual'
Aspen: <dc:creator> count matches Front Matter author count
Aspen: All manifest images must be JPEG
Aspen: alt attribute must not be empty
Aspen: No image over 4,000,000 pixels (W×H)
Aspen: Long alt text should be moved to a hidden container
Aspen: All body images must be at least 300 DPI
Aspen: should be center-aligned via class or inline style
Aspen: Page ruler (pagebreak marker) present for every non-blank PDF page
Aspen: Page citations (e.g. 'See page 23') are linked to the page id
Aspen: Glossary terms have two-way links between body and glossary
Aspen: External links must not have underline styling
